name: @streamline-pulse/creeba-iroh-mdns
description: Creeba iroh + mDNS transport for Bun/Node (desktop & server nodes): encrypted QUIC (holepunch + relay) with serverless mDNS discovery, plus ed25519 identity primitives. Implements @streamline-pulse/creeba-core's SyncTransport. Carries the native binding so the core stays dependency-free.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../scripts/fix-dts.mjs dist
